card.name: Start of platelet before 'let'
card.fires_on: The first part of a word split before a final 'let', mostly 'plate' in 'platelet(s)' in lab-count and dose-adjustment text. It also fires on 'orm' in 'cormlet'.

modes.label: plate before let
modes.description: The word 'plate' that begins 'platelet' or 'platelets' in blood count thresholds.
modes.example: Platelet Count Withhold TEMODAR if<< plate>>let less than 50 ×

modes.label: Other -let words
modes.description: The start of a rare noun ending in 'let', such as cormlet.

card.writes: It promotes the word piece 'let' as the next piece, finishing words like platelet.
card.plain: It fires on the first half of the word 'platelet' when the next piece must be 'let'.
